name: Image Studio
tagline: Upload, describe, and re-render on your box. Keep the gallery after an update.
description: Chain read, think and render steps on the models actually installed. Upload a png, describe it, re-render a change, refine a plate, or restyle with a model from the shelf. jpeg and webp are refused; png is the format this can decode on Linux. The box cannot edit pixels in an upload, so a chain that starts from a photo paints a new plate and says so. Gallery in ~/.local/share/tiiny-image-studio/. One inference at a time. NPU units used and free, never megabytes.

asks_for.why: to reach the Tiiny on your own network
plates are PNG files plus a JSON sidecar, one pair per image

privacy.stores: Generated PNGs and their prompts, seeds and models, on this machine only.
